title: Thai-Style Grilled Fennel
description: A flavorful and refreshing Thai-inspired dish featuring grilled fennel as the main ingredient. The nutty flavor of the fennel pairs perfectly with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of toasted peanuts.
instructions: Toss fennel wedges with grill seasoning, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Grill fennel for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice and honey.
Serve grilled fennel with a drizzle of lime-honey sauce, toasted peanuts, and chopped cilantro.
Garnish with additional cilantro and peanuts if desired.
